summary: Unpinned off-registry git dependency resolves to a third-party repository at install time
details: package.json declares `libsignal` as `git+https://github.com/whiskeysockets/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA, tag, or semver pin. On `npm install`, the dependency resolves to whatever the default branch of that external repository currently points at, and any lifecycle scripts in the resolved tree execute in the installer's environment. The referenced GitHub organization (`whiskeysockets`) is different from the publishing scope of this package (`@silent404`), so whoever controls that external repository's default branch controls code executed during installation of this package. This bypasses the npm registry's artifact-integrity checks and provides no version lock against upstream changes.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
